text: A little bird has no friends and sits alone, so what is this story about?
It is about a lonely bird.
How can you change the sentence about a lonely bird into a question that starts with Is?
Is it about a lonely bird?
A girl finds a lost kitten in this story, so can you fix one word in the sentence about it?
It is about a lost kitten.
A boy looks under every chair for his red cap, so what do you think the story is about?
I think it is about a lost cap.
How can you ask if the story is about a lonely rabbit?
Is it about a lonely rabbit?
Two children meet and start playing together at the park, so what do you think the story is about?
I think it is about two new friends.
In this pretend story a rabbit lifts a light box, so how can you tell us what it can do?
The rabbit can lift the box.
How does the sentence change when the box becomes too heavy for the rabbit to lift?
The rabbit cannot lift the box.
In this pretend story the bird knows where its nest is, so can you fix one word in the sentence?
The bird can find its nest.
In this pretend story a rabbit knows the way home, so how can it help the lost duck?
The rabbit can help the duck.
In this pretend story the nest is too high for a kitten, so what is the kitten unable to do?
The kitten cannot reach the nest.
Two friends are strong enough to move this box together, so how can you describe what they can do?
They can carry the box together.
Mia finds her dog and feels happy, so how can you join her feeling and the reason with because?
Mia is happy because she finds her dog.
How does the sentence change when Mia and Leo find their dog together and both feel happy?
They are happy because they find their dog.
Ben feels sad about his missing toy, so can you fix one word in this sentence?
Ben is sad because he cannot find his toy.
Lily has a new friend and feels happy, so how can you join her feeling and the reason with because?
Lily is happy because she has a new friend.
In this pretend story a lion is chasing two rabbits, so how do they feel and why?
They are scared because a lion is chasing them.
Ben has no one to play with and feels lonely, so how can you join his feeling and the reason with because?
Ben is lonely because he has no one to play with.
How can you point to and name the pencil in your hand?
This is a pencil.
How does the sentence change when you point to two pencils far away?
Those are pencils.
Two books are right beside you, so can you fix one word to show that they are near you?
These are books.
How can you point to and name the one book across the room?
That is a book.
How can you point to and name the two oranges in your hands?
These are oranges.
How can you point to and name the three birds in the faraway tree?
Those are birds.
Pretend you are Sam with a small pet rabbit, so how can you describe your pet starting with I?
I have a small rabbit.
How can you change Sam's sentence to tell someone else about his pet, starting with He?
He has a small rabbit.
Mia and Leo share two green lizards, so can you fix one word in the sentence?
They have two green lizards.
Eva's pet is a white kitten, so how can you describe her pet in a full sentence?
She has a white kitten.
Ben and Kim share two small goldfish, so how can you describe their pets in a full sentence?
They have two small goldfish.
Pretend you are Max with a big brown pet dog, so how can you describe your pet starting with I?
I have a big brown dog.
